q: Finish the verse: “Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a ____ be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.”
explain: John 3:3 — “Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.”

q: Finish the verse: “For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting ____.”
explain: John 3:16 — “For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.”

q: Finish the verse: “And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never ____.”
explain: John 6:35 — “And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.”

q: Finish the verse: “Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of ____.”
explain: John 8:12 — “Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.”

q: Finish the verse: “And ye shall ____ the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”
explain: John 8:32 — “And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”

q: Finish the verse: “The thief ____ not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.”
explain: John 10:10 — “The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.”

q: Finish the verse: “I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his ____ for the sheep.”
explain: John 10:11 — “I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.”

q: Finish the verse: “Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that ____ in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:”
explain: John 11:25 — “Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:”

q: Finish the verse: “A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have ____ you, that ye also love one another.”
explain: John 13:34 — “A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.”

q: Finish the verse: “In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I ____ to prepare a place for you.”
explain: John 14:2 — “In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.”

q: Finish the verse: “Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the ____, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.”
explain: John 14:6 — “Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.”

q: Finish the verse: “If ye shall ____ any thing in my name, I will do it.”
explain: John 14:14 — “If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.”

q: Finish the verse: “Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the ____ giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.”
explain: John 14:27 — “Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.”

q: Finish the verse: “I am the ____, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.”
explain: John 15:5 — “I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.”

q: Finish the verse: “Greater ____ hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.”
explain: John 15:13 — “Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.”

q: Finish the verse: “These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of ____ cheer; I have overcome the world.”
explain: John 16:33 — “These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.”

q: Finish the verse: “And they were all filled with the ____ Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.”
explain: Acts 2:4 — “And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.”

q: Finish the verse: “Then Peter said, Silver and ____ have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.”
explain: Acts 3:6 — “Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.”

q: Finish the verse: “Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under ____ given among men, whereby we must be saved.”
explain: Acts 4:12 — “Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.”

q: Finish the verse: “And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be ____, and thy house.”
explain: Acts 16:31 — “And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.”

q: Finish the verse: “For all have sinned, and ____ short of the glory of God;”
explain: Romans 3:23 — “For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;”

q: Finish the verse: “But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ ____ for us.”
explain: Romans 5:8 — “But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.”

q: Finish the verse: “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal ____ through Jesus Christ our Lord.”
explain: Romans 6:23 — “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.”

q: Finish the verse: “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the ____, but after the Spirit.”
explain: Romans 8:1 — “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.”

q: Finish the verse: “And we know that all things work together for good to them that ____ God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.”
explain: Romans 8:28 — “And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.”

q: Finish the verse: “That if thou shalt confess with thy ____ the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.”
explain: Romans 10:9 — “That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.”

q: Finish the verse: “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the ____ of God.”
explain: Romans 10:17 — “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.”

q: Finish the verse: “I beseech you therefore, ____, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.”
explain: Romans 12:1 — “I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.”

q: Finish the verse: “And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and ____, will of God.”
explain: Romans 12:2 — “And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.”

q: Finish the verse: “Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and ____ in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.”
explain: Romans 15:13 — “Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.”

q: Finish the verse: “But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that ____ him.”
explain: 1 Corinthians 2:9 — “But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.”

q: Finish the verse: “And now abideth faith, ____, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.”
explain: 1 Corinthians 13:13 — “And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.”

q: Finish the verse: “But thanks be to God, which ____ us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.”
explain: 1 Corinthians 15:57 — “But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.”

q: Finish the verse: “Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the ____ of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.”
explain: 1 Corinthians 15:58 — “Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.”

q: Finish the verse: “Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be ____.”
explain: 1 Corinthians 16:13 — “Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.”

q: Finish the verse: “(For we ____ by faith, not by sight:)”
explain: 2 Corinthians 5:7 — “(For we walk by faith, not by sight:)”

q: Finish the verse: “Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: ____ things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.”
explain: 2 Corinthians 5:17 — “Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.”

q: Finish the verse: “Every ____ according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.”
explain: 2 Corinthians 9:7 — “Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.”

q: Finish the verse: “But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, ____, faith,”
explain: Galatians 5:22 — “But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,”

q: Finish the verse: “For by ____ are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:”
explain: Ephesians 2:8 — “For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:”

q: Finish the verse: “Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that ____ in us,”
explain: Ephesians 3:20 — “Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,”

q: Finish the verse: “And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake ____ forgiven you.”
explain: Ephesians 4:32 — “And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.”

q: Finish the verse: “Finally, my ____, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.”
explain: Ephesians 6:10 — “Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.”

q: Finish the verse: “Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to ____ against the wiles of the devil.”
explain: Ephesians 6:11 — “Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.”

q: Finish the verse: “For we wrestle not against flesh and ____, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.”
explain: Ephesians 6:12 — “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.”

q: Finish the verse: “Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the ____ of Jesus Christ:”
explain: Philippians 1:6 — “Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:”

q: Finish the verse: “For to me to live is Christ, and to ____ is gain.”
explain: Philippians 1:21 — “For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.”

q: Finish the verse: “That at the ____ of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;”
explain: Philippians 2:10 — “That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;”

q: Finish the verse: “Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be ____ known unto God.”
explain: Philippians 4:6 — “Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.”

q: Finish the verse: “And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall ____ your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.”
explain: Philippians 4:7 — “And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.”

q: Finish the verse: “But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in ____ by Christ Jesus.”
explain: Philippians 4:19 — “But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.”

q: Finish the verse: “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of ____, and of love, and of a sound mind.”
explain: 2 Timothy 1:7 — “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.”

q: Finish the verse: “Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the ____ of truth.”
explain: 2 Timothy 2:15 — “Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.”

q: Finish the verse: “I have fought a ____ fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:”
explain: 2 Timothy 4:7 — “I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:”

q: Finish the verse: “But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that ____ to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.”
explain: Hebrews 11:6 — “But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.”

q: Finish the verse: “If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that ____ to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.”
explain: James 1:5 — “If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.”

q: Finish the verse: “Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the ____ of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.”
explain: James 1:17 — “Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.”

q: Finish the verse: “Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous ____ availeth much.”
explain: James 5:16 — “Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.”

q: Finish the verse: “Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, ____ about, seeking whom he may devour:”
explain: 1 Peter 5:8 — “Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:”

q: Finish the verse: “If we confess our sins, he is faithful and ____ to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.”
explain: 1 John 1:9 — “If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.”

q: Finish the verse: “Ye are of God, little ____, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.”
explain: 1 John 4:4 — “Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.”

q: Finish the verse: “He that loveth not ____ not God; for God is love.”
explain: 1 John 4:8 — “He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.”

q: Finish the verse: “There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear ____ torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.”
explain: 1 John 4:18 — “There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.”

q: Finish the verse: “And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the ____.”
explain: Revelation 12:11 — “And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.”

q: Finish the verse: “In the beginning God ____ the heaven and the earth.”
explain: Genesis 1:1 — “In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.”

q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD God formed man of the ____ of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.”
explain: Genesis 2:7 — “And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.”

q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD God said, It is not ____ that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.”
explain: Genesis 2:18 — “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.”

q: Finish the verse: “And the rain was upon the earth forty ____ and forty nights.”
explain: Genesis 7:12 — “And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.”

q: Finish the verse: “I do set my bow in the ____, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.”
explain: Genesis 9:13 — “I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.”

q: Finish the verse: “And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy ____ great; and thou shalt be a blessing:”
explain: Genesis 12:2 — “And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:”

q: Finish the verse: “Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will ____ unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.”
explain: Genesis 18:14 — “Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.”

q: Finish the verse: “And Abraham said, My ____, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.”
explain: Genesis 22:8 — “And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.”

q: Finish the verse: “And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the ____ of God ascending and descending on it.”
explain: Genesis 28:12 — “And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.”
